title: Welcome Yuanchang Technology (元场科技) as a Unique Partner
summary: 2024 is AIGC’s commercialization year. Unique Capital × Unique Research launched the Unique Partner Network (UPN). Introducing another partner:
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Partner · May 14, 2024

2024 is AIGC’s commercialization year. Unique Capital × Unique Research launched the Unique Partner Network (UPN). Introducing another partner:

About Yuanchang Technology

Founded October 2023; mission “intelligence makes humans healthier”; vision “AI new-healthcare industry leader.” End-to-end medical data-element services from production → circulation → value mining toward a smart-health ecosystem.

3 national patents pending; LOIs with hospitals and local CDCs. Founder’s prior Guangdong CDC regional health-management network is expanding nationally. Core founders are Peking University alumni (CS MS/PhD); core team of 10 all from Project 985 schools (8 with master’s+).

Flagship: medical digitalization Agent aiming to cut hospital/regulator research/ops/clinical/admin cost toward ~10% of prior — ~¥10B-scale TAM; path to AI new-healthcare (¥100B) and personal health management (¥1T). Scenarios: hospital lean ops, medical insurance, research, quality, regional CDC.

Products

Clinical research & disease specialty DBs: MoE specialty-disease DB — only market solution claimed as serviceable on-demand field extraction from unstructured notes (cost/accuracy/new-field/reuse pain of traditional specialty DBs).

Lean ops management platform: Agent-native “digital employees” for hospital managers — full-chain lean analysis vs siloed dashboards.

CDC Agent secure collaboration network: multi-point monitoring beyond hospital-only data; infectious-disease multi-trigger early warning and multi-agency coordination.

Cases

National Cancer Center specialty DB: AI extraction + unified middle layer for secondary field composition; understands varied physician phrasing for research accuracy.

Fujian Medical Insurance Bureau: data-sandbox secure share / privacy compute for data-element trading — “usable but invisible” closed-env compute after form demand → sandbox sim → live.

Partner imagery — attach on ingest (7 images).

— END —
